title: Build a Multilingual Site: Cultures, Translations and a Picker | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors expect a site in their own language, and a site that shows one language to everyone leaves part of its audience out.

Orchard Core handles this with three features: Localization defines the cultures of the site, Content Localization gives a content item one translation for each culture, and Content Culture Picker adds a language menu to the navigation bar.

In this video:
• How a multilingual site works
• Enable the features
• Add the cultures
• Make a type translatable
• Translate a page
• Add the culture picker
• Switch languages on the site
• How the picker chooses a page
